Load SVs and sample data
```{r load_data}
all.sample.metadata <- 
    load_sample_metadata() %>%
    select(SampleID, sex, age, RACE, Biobank, PMI_mins, AD_CERAD_withDLB, Braak_3levels, CDR_3levels)
all.SVs.df <- 
    check_cached_results(
        results_file=here('results', 'all.SV.data.rds'),
        force_redo=TRUE,
        results_fnc=
            function() {
                list_all_SVs() %>%
                mutate(
                    SVs.df=
                        future_pmap(
                            .l=list(SVs.filepath),
                            .f=
                                function(SVs.filepath, sample.metadata) {
                                    SVs.filepath %>% 
                                    read_tsv(show_col_types=FALSE) %>% 
                                    left_join(
                                        sample.metadata,
                                        by=join_by(SampleID)
                                    )
                                },
                            sample.metadata=all.sample.metadata,
                            .progress=TRUE
                        )
                )
            }
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        SVs.estimated=
            pmap(
                .l=list(SVs.df),
                .f=~ .x %>% colnames() %>% str_detect('^SV') %>% sum()
            ) %>% 
            unlist(),
        z.score.counts=ifelse(z.score.counts, 'zscore -> SVs', 'unscaled -> SVs')
    ) %>% 
    select(-c(n.SVs, SVs.filepath))
```

# Correlation of SVs between sample sets

```{r compute_SV_SV_correlation}
# #| eval: false
compute_SV_correlations <- function(SVs.df.1, SVs.df.2, ...) {
    SVs.df.1 <- 
        SVs.df.1 %>% 
        as.data.frame() %>%
        column_to_rownames('SampleID') %>% 
        select(starts_with('SV'))
    SVs.df.2 <- 
        SVs.df.2 %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        column_to_rownames('SampleID') %>% 
        select(starts_with('SV'))
    common.samples <- 
        intersect(rownames(SVs.df.1), rownames(SVs.df.2))
    cor.mat <- 
        cor(
            SVs.df.1[common.samples, ],
            SVs.df.2[common.samples, ]
        ) %>%
        as.data.frame()
    rownames(cor.mat) <- colnames(SVs.df.1)
    colnames(cor.mat) <- colnames(SVs.df.2)
    cor.mat %>% 
    rownames_to_column('SVs.1') %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    pivot_longer(
        -c(SVs.1),
        names_to='SVs.2',
        values_to='cor'
    )
}
compute_all_SV_correlations <- function(){
    tribble(
        ~AD.definition.column, ~sample.strategy.1, ~sample.strategy.2, 
        'AD_CERAD_withDLB',    'All.Samples',      'All.Samples',
        'AD_CERAD_withDLB',    'All.Samples',      'AD.Samples',
        'AD_CERAD_withDLB',    'All.Samples',      'Control.Samples',
        'AD_CERAD_withDLB',    'AD.Samples',       'Control.Samples',
        # 'AD_CERAD_withDLB',    'No.Others',        'AD.Samples',
        # 'AD_CERAD_withDLB',    'No.Others',        'Control.Samples',
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
        all.SVs.df,
        relationship='many-to-many',
        by=join_by(AD.definition.column, sample.strategy.1 == sample.strategy)

    ) %>% 
    inner_join(
        all.SVs.df,
        suffix=c('.1', '.2'),
        relationship='many-to-many',
        by=
            join_by(
                CPM.cutoff, residual.model, 
                AD.definition.column,
                # SVs.est.strategy, SVs.estimated,
                z.score.counts, 
                sample.strategy.2 == sample.strategy
            )
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
        SV.corr=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=compute_SV_correlations,
            )
    ) %>% 
    unnest(SV.corr)
}
SV.correlations.df <- 
    check_cached_results(
        results_file=here('results', 'all.SV.data.tsv'),
        force_redo=TRUE,
        results_fnc=compute_all_SV_correlations
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
        cor.label=round(cor, 2),
        comparison=
            case_when(
                sample.strategy.1 == sample.strategy.2 ~ sample.strategy.1,
                TRUE ~ glue('{sample.strategy.1} vs {sample.strategy.2}'),
            ),
        across(
            .cols=c(SVs.1, SVs.2),
            .fn=~ fct_reorder(.x, .x %>% str_remove('^SV') %>% as.integer())
        )
        # sv.int.1=SVs.1 %>% str_remove('^SV') %>% as.integer(),
        # SVs.1=fct_reorder(SVs.1, ),
        # sv.int.2=SVs.2 %>% str_remove('^SV') %>% as.integer(),
        # SVs.2=fct_reorder(SVs.2, sv.int.2)
    )
```

Here we plot the correlation of SVs estimated on different set of samples, specifically we compare SVs estimated from AD samples only or Controls only to All samples.
We only compare the SV correlations between common samples for each pair of different SV sets.

# Correlation of SVs and Sample Metadata

```{r compute_SV_metadata_correlation}
# #| eval: false
#| cache: true
model.variables <- 
    c(
        'RACE',
        'sex',
        'Biobank',
        ALL_PHENOTYPE_COLUMNS
    )
make_correlation_data <- function(SVs.df, model.vars, ...) {
    # SVs.df=all.SVs.df$SVs.df[[1]]; model.vars=c('sex', 'RACE', 'Biobank', ALL_PHENOTYPE_COLUMNS)
    for (variable in model.vars) {
        is.constant <- SVs.df %>% pull(variable) %>% {all(duplicated(.)[-1L])}
        if (is.constant) {
            model.vars <- model.vars[model.vars != variable]
        }
    }
    all.vars <- 
        c(
            model.vars,
            grep('^SV', colnames(SVs.df), value=TRUE)
        )
    SVs.df %>% 
    canCorPairs(

        formula=sprintf('~ %s', paste(all.vars, collapse='+')) %>% formula(),

        data=.

    ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column('Var1') %>% 
    pivot_longer(
        -c(Var1),
        names_to='Var2',
        values_to='corr'
    ) %>% 
    mutate(across(c(Var1, Var2), ~ factor(.x, levels=all.vars)))
}
compute_all_SV_metadata_correlations <- function(model.variables) {
    all.SVs.df %>% 
    mutate(
        corr.df=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=make_correlation_data,
                model.vars=model.variables
            )
    ) %>% 
    select(-SVs.df) %>% 
    unnest(corr.df)
}
SV.metadata.correlations.df <- 
    check_cached_results(
        results_file=here('results', 'all.SV.metadata.correlations.tsv'),
        force_redo=TRUE,
        results_fnc=compute_all_SV_metadata_correlations,
        model.variables=model.variables
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
        across(
            .cols=c(Var1, Var2),
            .names='{.col}.is.SV',
            .f=~ !.x %in% model.variables
        )
    ) %>% 
    filter(Var1.is.SV != Var2.is.SV) %>% 
    mutate(
        SVs=
            case_when(
                 Var1.is.SV & !Var2.is.SV ~ Var1,
                !Var1.is.SV &  Var2.is.SV ~ Var2
            ),
        phenotypes=
            case_when(
                 Var1.is.SV & !Var2.is.SV ~ Var2,
                !Var1.is.SV &  Var2.is.SV ~ Var1
            ),
        SVs=fct_reorder(SVs, SVs %>% str_remove('^SV') %>% as.integer()),
        corr.label=round(corr, 2)
    ) %>%
    select(-c(Var1, Var1.is.SV, Var2, Var2.is.SV))
```

Here we plot the correlation of estimated SVs with various sample characteristics e.g. AD phenotypes, Age and model co-variates.

```{r plot_SV_metadata_correlation}
) %>% 
render_tabset(
    tabset_vars=nesting.vars,
    output_vars=figures

```

# CRD Elbow Plot of LEFs vs SVs

First load all the data where we calcualted all decorate CRD LEFs from separate matrices with different sets of SVs regressed out i.e. {1}, {1,2}, {1,2,3,...N} etc. 
Most matrices only had 1-4 SVs estimated.
```{r load_elbow_data}
#| eval: false
#| cache: true
all.elbow.data.df <- 
    ELBOW_RESULTS_DIR %>% 
    parse_results_filelist(
        suffix='elbow.plot.data.tsv',
        filename.column.name='filename'
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename('elbow.filepath'=filepath) %>% 
    select(-c(filename)) %>%
    {read_tsv(.$elbow.filepath)} %>% count(SVs.included, meanClusterSize)
```
